schema_baseline.note: The business seed is intentionally empty. The shared runtime initializes site binding/library tables and the clone applies exactly three idempotent business migrations.

quote_scenario.note: Synthetic scenario used for the authorized source funnel walk and the clone's canonical rating tests. ZIP 44301 comes from the source form example.
quote_scenario.email_policy: Use only the recorded non-deliverable synthetic address; REAL_EMAIL_AUTHORIZED=false.

entities.note: The first post-reset quote is deterministically WB100001 and uses the frozen timestamp.
Pets are created only by local quote operations; no member pet is seeded.
Each created pet receives one deterministic default selection whose price provenance is explicit.
The first post-reset enrollment is APH-000001. Rows contain no payment fields and are unique by quote.
All three rows use the frozen clock and remain after deterministic reset.
